import numpy as np
import bisect
import statistics
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def task_func(data, value):
    if len(data) == 0:
        return np.array([]), 0
    avg = statistics.mean(data)
    greater_than_avg = np.array([x for x in data if x > avg])
    sorted_data = sorted(data)
    count = len(sorted_data) - bisect.bisect_right(sorted_data, value)
    plt.hist(sorted_data)
    return greater_than_avg, count
